title: E2EE detection conflated with unknown bodyType
description: §6 says 'when a message's bodyType is any other value [than the three plaintext types], the server MUST treat the body as opaque.' This means an unknown plaintext type (e.g. text/html) suppresses the snippet even though the content is unencrypted. The spec never explains how the server detects that a Chat is E2EE vs. just having an unusual body type. These two concepts must be separated.
close_reason: Added encrypted Boolean field to ChatMessageEntry. bodySnippet omission now keyed on encrypted:true, not bodyType allowlist. Server sets encrypted based on bodyType, but the omission rule is stable across future plaintext type additions.
